messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000110": The Cinder team owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder team, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000319": The product catalog depends on the image resizer for thumbnails.  (about: product catalog, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000156": The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000268" [constraint]: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000221": The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: ledger service, the cache change)
- memory_id "1000171" [decision]: Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000116": The indexer is owned by the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, indexer)
- memory_id "1000271": The image resizer is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000261" [decision]: Lena takes over the pager rotation for the Boreal team from Marcus in the cycle starting 2025-03-17.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000281": Team Dune observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: team Dune, the cache change, notification service)
- memory_id "1000169": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000001": The Atlas team in 2025 consists of Priya Raman and Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000167": The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000161" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14)
- memory_id "1000237": From 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000215" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff because the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000225": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000026": Diego is on the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, Diego)
- memory_id "1000296" [constraint]: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000033": The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
Existing entity names: Cinder team, product catalog, image resizer, indexer, ledger service, the cache change, notifier, Ember team, Boreal team, Lena, Marcus, team Dune, notification service, Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz, Postgres 14, webhook dispatcher, push provider, Diego, billing API

The note:

[2025-04-17] standup/cinder/2025-04-17: Decision: the catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table, because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.
